title: Controlled experiments (A/B tests)
description: Experiment plans with a decision rule set before traffic is assigned, and reports that state effect and uncertainty.

sources.title: Kohavi, Tang and Xu, Trustworthy Online Controlled Experiments: A Practical Guide to A/B Testing

rules.instruction: For an A/B test, state the hypothesis, primary metric, guardrails, unit of randomization and stopping rule before assigning traffic.
rules.verification: Review event definitions and the planned duration. Check assignment balance and sample ratios before interpreting observed differences.

rules.instruction: When reviewing an A/B test, record the estimated effect and uncertainty along with any problems in assignment or logging. Apply the agreed decision rule before rolling out.
rules.verification: Reconcile the report with the experiment plan and verify that each guardrail passed or has a recorded decision from the owner.
